cristalquery.name: QueryBasicItemList
cristalquery.query: SELECT ip."UUID", MAX(ip."VALUE") FILTER (WHERE ip."NAME" = 'Module') AS "Module", MAX(ip."VALUE") FILTER (WHERE ip."NAME" = 'Type') AS "Type", MAX(ip."VALUE") FILTER (WHERE ip."NAME" = 'Name') AS "Name", MAX(ip."VALUE") FILTER (WHERE ip."NAME" = 'Version') AS "Version", COUNT(*) OVER() AS TotalCount FROM "ITEM_PROPERTY" ip LEFT JOIN "DOMAIN_PATH" dp ON ip."UUID" = dp."TARGET" WHERE dp."PATH" LIKE '@{domainPath}%' GROUP BY ip."UUID", dp."PATH" ORDER BY "Type", "Name", "Version" OFFSET @{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT @{limit} ROWS ONLY;
